summary: 优先复用本机已安装的OpenAI Game Studio game-playtest、three-webgl-game、web-3d-asset-pipeline。它们与当前plain Three.js/Rapier/GLB栈匹配；项目自己的pawborough-game-client和static-architecture仍是角色/相机/碰撞/资产契约的权威。无须重写引擎。

candidates.name: game-playtest
candidates.license: MIT (Game Studio plugin manifest; per-file license not separately verified)
candidates.fit: Playwright浏览器试玩、WebGL截图、主要操作、HUD/渲染分别检查、碰撞/材质/性能异常复现报告。
candidates.evidence: Upstream SKILL.md readable; locally present in cached Game Studio 0.1.2. Includes ordered playtest loop and 3D checks; repo links checklist and WebGL debugging references. Existing Playwright means little added setup.
candidates.cost: Needs task-specific route and viewports; no Pawborough test script is supplied. SpectorJS only if perf/render diagnosis is unclear.
candidates.recommendation: 之后的真实浏览器试玩直接使用，复用现有Playwright。

candidates.name: three-webgl-game
candidates.license: MIT (Game Studio plugin manifest; per-file license not separately verified)
candidates.evidence: Upstream SKILL.md readable; locally present in cached Game Studio 0.1.2; guidance explicitly describes vanilla imperative Three.js, Rapier, GLB, KTX2, Meshopt and SpectorJS.
candidates.cost: Architecture guidance may overlap current modules and has no validated Pawborough cycling/camera values; do not migrate directory or rewrite.
candidates.recommendation: 新增或调整单个runtime subsystem时按需参考。

candidates.name: web-3d-asset-pipeline
candidates.license: MIT (Game Studio plugin manifest; per-file license not separately verified)
candidates.evidence: Upstream SKILL.md readable; locally present in cached Game Studio 0.1.2; workflow explicitly covers author-clean-export-optimize-validate-runtime delivery.
candidates.cost: glTF Transform is a recommendation, not an installed dependency or proven benefit; may duplicate existing generators and inspection scripts.
candidates.recommendation: 有新资产、压缩或资源预算决策时作为清单；先复用已验收资产和仓库工具。

candidates.name: web-game-foundations
candidates.license: MIT (Game Studio plugin manifest; per-file license not separately verified)
candidates.fit: 可借鉴simulation/render/UI责任边界用于较大增量阶段设计；适合早期架构规划。
candidates.evidence: Upstream skill file readable; included by Game Studio as shared architecture path; locally installed with plugin 0.1.2.
candidates.cost: Pawborough引擎、v1范围和阶段入口已存在；完整套用会重复决策。
candidates.recommendation: 只在具体责任边界不清时看对应段落，不作为每次补丁强制门槛。
